text_intro:
With over 18 years of experience in data science, software engineering, and data analysis, I am Rodrigo Silva Pereira, a specialist focused on transforming complex data into actionable insights and high-impact solutions.

Currently, I work as a Senior Data Scientist at the Ministry of Management and Innovation in Public Services , where I lead initiatives that combine Machine Learning , Natural Language Processing (NLP) , and robust orchestration of data pipelines using Airflow and Docker .

My career is marked by achievements such as the development of more than 10 ETL pipelines, the implementation of advanced machine learning models, and the optimization of computational resources, resulting in improvements of up to 25%. I have a solid academic background with Master's degree (MSc) in Computing Applied to Modeling and Simulation and MBA with emphasis on Data Science, AI, and Big Data.

I am a professional passionate about innovation, with expertise in tools such as Python, PL/SQL, and Git, always seeking the next challenge to generate transformative results through collaborative work.

Check out some of my current work and skills to see my technical expertise .
